title: Customer Unaware or Forgot Vehicle Features
summary: This topic centers on customers being unaware of certain vehicle features or struggling to remember details, with one example framing the vehicle-location feature as helpful for avoiding confusion about where the car is parked.

negative.summary: The only negative example describes the vehicle-location feature as useful because the customer can become confused about remembering where the car is parked in large or changing parking areas.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly note customers being unaware of features, intending to remember guidance, or being unable to recall details without enough context to judge satisfaction.

limitations: Most examples are brief service-style notes with limited context, so customer satisfaction cannot usually be determined.
The cluster combines several loosely related situations, including forgotten details, unfamiliar features, and feature reminders, rather than one clearly defined issue.
Examples are insufficient to determine whether lack of awareness reflects a product problem, a training gap, or a one-off interaction.
